imageUrl.label: Image URL
imageUrl.description: URL of the image to display in the album

bitmap-patterns.title: Bitmap Patterns
bitmap-patterns.description: Demonstrating using custom classes to create bitmap patterns. See /utils/pre-satori.ts for more details. Edit this recipe at /app/recipes/screens/bitmap-patterns.tsx

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia Article
wikipedia.description: A component that displays random Wikipedia articles.

bitcoin-price.title: Crypto Price Tracker
bitcoin-price.description: A component that displays the current cryptocurrency price and market data. Supports any cryptocurrency available on CoinGecko.

cryptoSymbol.label: Cryptocurrency Symbol
cryptoSymbol.description: The CoinGecko ID of the cryptocurrency (e.g., 'bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'cardano'). Defaults to 'bitcoin'.

weather.title: Weather Forecast
weather.description: A component that displays current weather data from Open-Meteo API. Supports configurable locations via latitude/longitude or location name.

location.label: Location
location.description: City or place name to fetch weather for

responsive-example.title: Responsive Example
responsive-example.description: An example component demonstrating responsive design patterns and layout techniques for bitmap displays.

meals-of-the-week.title: Meals of the week
meals-of-the-week.description: Weekly weekday meal schedule (snack, lunch, dinner). Data refreshes every 15 minutes. Requires REACT_RENDERER=browser and the Chrome sidecar for TRMNL Framework styling.

color-calendar.title: Color Calendar
color-calendar.description: Current month calendar with Danish public holidays highlighted in red. Defaults to 1872×1404 (TRMNL X); the 4:3 layout scales to any canvas.

google-calendar.title: Google Calendar
google-calendar.description: Your Google Calendar: a small month overview (red = Danish holidays, green = weekends/vacation) plus a Monday-first week view listing each day's events. Connect via the dashboard. Defaults to 1600×1200 (Inky Impression 13.3); scales to any panel.

vacationCalendar.label: Vacation calendar name
vacationCalendar.description: All-day events from any calendar whose name matches this (case-insensitive substring) colour their days green as vacation. Defaults to 'ferie'.

country.label: Holiday country
country.description: ISO country code for public-holiday highlighting. Only 'DK' is supported today.

showWeekNumbers.label: Show ISO week number
showWeekNumbers.description: Display the ISO week number in the week-view header.

calendarColors.label: Calendar colours (JSON)
calendarColors.description: JSON mapping a calendar name (case-insensitive substring) to a colour: black, blue, yellow, green, red, white (or a #hex). Holiday calendars are always red. Example: {"Work":"blue"}.

not-found.title: Not Found Recipe
not-found.description: A fallback recipe displayed when a requested recipe is not found.

playdate.title: Playdate Catalog
playdate.description: Cycles through title cards from the Playdate Catalog (play.date/games). Picks a random game each render and shows its feature art — a natural fit for 1-bit e-ink.

gameSlug.label: Pin a game (optional)
gameSlug.description: Catalog slug to always show, e.g. 'mars-after-midnight'. Leave blank to cycle through random games.
